findings: Actual installed artifact identifies FTB Quests2001.4.22/FTB Team/All Rights Reserved/Forge javafml. This review is pinned to its exact Jar/classes, not a presumed online current version or historical different QA package.

ItemTask readData defaults count>=1 and loads consume_items, only_from_crafting, match_nbt tristates plus weak_nbt_match/task_screen_only. shouldMatchNBT TRUE/FALSE/DEFAULT is confirmed against actual synthetic switch bytecode; DEFAULT consults ftbquests:match_nbt or legacy itemfilters:check_nbt runtime item tags, not mere existence of a configured tag compound.

ItemTask.test returns true for an empty configured stack; otherwise delegates to ItemMatchingSystem. Registered adapters may override ordinary equality and are selected first. This review does not enumerate registrations in every loaded mod or prove runtime tag contents; all ordinary-stack matching conclusions retain the non-adapter/default matching boundary.

Default equality first accepts same object, then requires identical Item. Two untagged stacks match. If NBT matching is disabled, tag differences do not matter. If enabled, compareNbt receives configured tag as tagA and obtained tag as tagB. A null configured tag returns true even for a tagged obtained stack: enabling match_nbt on an ID-only task is insufficient to demand a particular NBT variant.

Non-null required tag rejects null obtained tag and different tag types. Strict compound mode requires equal key sets and recursively matches values; fuzzy mode permits additional obtained compound keys but still checks each required field recursively. Lists remain equal length and index-sensitive, even with fuzzy compounds. Empty required compound in fuzzy mode is not a functional variant predicate.

Neither strict nor fuzzy fixed-tag matching expresses InfusionTraits.active eligibility, family conflict or capacity policy. A wolf/crab trait may be in another legitimate slot or have other legal slots, so strict recipe-output equality can reject a functional item; a weak single marker can admit invalid/over-capacity/conflicting cases. Prior complete functional consumer review is reused, not counted again.

Normal non-consuming submitTask uses the current inventory summary and only raises TeamData progress to the larger capped matching count. It does not prove who crafted, paid, traded, picked up a particular ItemEntity, or preserve an intended recipient UUID. Removing the item does not lower progress in this method. Main inventory items are scanned; Curios/armor/offhand and other players are not included by this listener summary.

only_from_crafting on a non-consuming task tests the supplied craftedItem event argument and adds its count, rather than requiring present inventory. The method alone does not validate recipe identity, original materials/XP cost, successful ownership transfer or event origin; crafting event caller/payment handling were not expanded here.

Consuming task on empty craftedItem loops main inventory, inserts matching items, advances progress server-side when not simulated and returns a reduced copied stack. This is a resource-submission action, separate from the earlier recipe/menu price; adding it for variant acquisition risks requiring a second payment or removing the acquired item. No new consuming node is created.

Inventory listener rejects fake players, requires existing ServerQuestFile, a team and unlocked TeamData, then uses player context and canStartTasks; skips sourceTask, chooses submit versus crafting task lists and clears its summary. Slot listener only schedules/checks nonempty main-inventory updates, with detection delay clamped0..200; deferred scheduler details and complete caller lifecycle not expanded.

Existing plain scale_plate and tiger_claw tasks were already read in the pinned prior receipt; their source hashes remain identical. They are preserved as original base tasks/IDs/rewards and cannot be relabeled variant-specific. No claim is made that all runtime adapters/tags or task inheritance are now accepted.

Integration must retain separate material-source discovery, existing prerequisites, actual recipe/menu/trade payment, valid full functional variant and arrival to the intended player. Reuse the lawful existing price once; add no duplicate item reward. Native cloud/effect outcome remains separate from poison-smoke acquisition. Applicable new variant acquisition research1000 and independent/native receipt gates remain unresolved.
